The vanilla geo is identical between Adult and Child, but position is different. Child Link's OoT serves as the new model base, so Adult OoT requires an offset to put it in the same position. I have determined the following offsets to be as close to vanilla as possible: Translate X: 0.59, Y: 0.22, Z: 2.29. Rotate X: -172.987, Y: -184.592, Z: 175.432.
